# Design system

<!-- generated by tools/design_doc.js from design/tokens.json – do not edit by hand, run: node tools/design_doc.js --write -->

All important design values of the app – colours, type scale, spacing, radii, focus, motion, layers and layout constants – are stored once in [`tokens.json`](tokens.json); every icon is one SVG file in [`icons/`](icons/). Everything else is generated from these two places, so a value is changed in one spot and the change reaches every screen. The files are plain JSON and SVG on purpose: a port to another TV platform can read them directly.

## How to change something

1. Edit the value (and its description) in `design/tokens.json`, or an icon in `design/icons/<name>.svg`.
2. Run `npm run spec` – regenerates this page, the accent palette in `src/core/accent.js`, the icon columns in `src/ui/icons.js` and the token and icon tables of the product spec `SPEC.md` (`node tools/design_doc.js --write` does only the design files).
3. Colours used in images (icon rows, background, pointer outline, QR code) or a changed icon: run `node tools/make_assets.js` (needs `rsvg-convert`).
4. Run `npm test`. The build replaces the placeholders in `src/css/app.css` with the values.

New icon: add `design/icons/<name>.svg` (28 × 28 view box, `currentColor` for stroke/fill, same `<g>` wrapper as the others), append the name to `design/icons/order.json`, then steps 2–4.

## What is enforced

- The build fails on any colour literal (`#hex`, `rgb()`/`rgba()`, `hsl()`, colour names) in `src/css/*.css` – every colour is a token. `node tools/tokenize_css.js --write` converts new literals that already have a token and lists the ones that still need one.
- The build fails on any placeholder that does not resolve (typo or deleted token).
- `npm test` fails when this page, the token/icon blocks of the product spec, `src/core/accent.js`, `src/ui/icons.js`, `src/assets/icons.svg`/`icons.json` are out of date, when an icon in `src/ui/icons.js` has no SVG or an SVG is not in the sprite, when a token is used nowhere (not in `src/css`, not as icon row colour, not via `T.color()` in `tools/`; an intentionally free step of a scale is marked `"reserved": true`), and when a brand-specific accent colour appears in `tokens.json` (it belongs only in `brand/<id>.json`).
- Values that are one-off geometry (positions, sizes of single elements, circles) stay as plain px in the CSS.

Placeholder in CSS: `@<group>.<name>@` (replaced at build time by tools/build.js). Accent colours are written as `@accent@`.

**Scaling:** All sizes are px on the fixed 1280 x 720 stage (the TV upscales it to the panel). For a port to a bigger stage multiply every px token by the stage factor and round to whole px: 1920 x 1080 = x1.5, 3840 x 2160 = x3. Colours, font weights, letter-spacing ratios, durations, easing curves, z-layers and the focus scale stay as they are. 1 px hairlines become 2 px at x1.5 or more so they stay visible. Font sizes scale too (16 px minimum becomes 24 px at 1080p).

## Colours (`@c.…@`)

Dark theme. Contrast numbers are measured against `bg`. Rules: body text never below 7:1 (so text-1/text-2); text-3 only at 16 px or larger and never over images; semi-transparent colours only on small areas (Orsay repaints large alpha areas slowly).

| `@c.panel@` | `#121316` | Opaque side panels: expanded navigation, selection/help panel. Every accent colour is checked to reach 4.5:1 on it |
| `@c.surface-1@` | `#17191C` | Dialogs, Up Next card, settings description, pointer arrow pills, list cards |
| `@c.surface-2@` | `#1F2226` | Image placeholders, on-screen keys, chips, cover backgrounds |

## Accent palette

The accent colour means focus or progress only. The user picks one of these colours (Settings > Display > Accent colour). In CSS always write @accent@ (not a palette token): tools/build.js fills in the brand default and generates one `.ac-<id>` variant per other colour. Each brand profile (brand/<id>.json) picks its default with `accentId` and may override that colour's value with its own `accent` (that override lives only in the brand profile). Every colour must reach 4.5:1 with on-accent text on it and 4.5:1 on `panel` (tests/accent.test.js). Generated into src/core/accent.js (PALETTE).

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `amber` | `#F2A93B` | Amber |
| `coral` | `#FF7A5C` | Coral |
| `rose` | `#F78FB3` | Rose |
| `violet` | `#A78BFA` | Violet |
| `blue` | `#5AA9FF` | Blue |
| `teal` | `#2EC4B6` | Teal (default of the public brand) |
| `green` | `#5CCB7A` | Green |

## Typography (`@ty.…@`)

Design font Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1, rsms.me/inter), weights 400 and 600. The 2014 build ships no font file and falls back to the TV's sans-serif (SPEC B-15); a port should bundle Inter or use a platform font with similar metrics. Hard minimum 16 px for every text (build gate). Each style: size / line-height / weight (/ letter-spacing). Rules whose size and line-height match a style use that style's tokens.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@ty.family@` | `'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` | Font stack (Inter first where installed or bundled); the TV system font runs wider, so text boxes keep 10 % reserve |
| `@ty.display.size@` | `40px` | display: hero title, detail title without logo |
| `@ty.display.lh@` | `48px` | display line height |
| `@ty.display.weight@` | `600` | display weight |
| `@ty.display.ls@` | `-0.5px` | display letter-spacing |
| `@ty.h1.size@` | `32px` | h1: page titles, episode title in details |
| `@ty.h1.lh@` | `40px` | h1 line height |
| `@ty.h1.weight@` | `600` | h1 weight |
| `@ty.h1.ls@` | `-0.3px` | h1 letter-spacing |
| `@ty.h2.size@` | `24px` | h2: dialog titles, OSD title |
| `@ty.h2.lh@` | `32px` | h2 line height |
| `@ty.h2.weight@` | `600` | h2 weight |
| `@ty.row.size@` | `22px` | row: row headers, search field |
| `@ty.row.lh@` | `32px` | row line height |
| `@ty.row.weight@` | `600` | row weight |
| `@ty.title.size@` | `20px` | title: navigation, tabs, settings labels |
| `@ty.title.lh@` | `28px` | title line height |
| `@ty.title.weight@` | `600` | title weight |
| `@ty.body.size@` | `18px` | body: descriptions, buttons (with weight 600) |
| `@ty.body.lh@` | `26px` | body line height |
| `@ty.body.weight@` | `400` | body weight |
| `@ty.small.size@` | `16px` | small: metadata, hints, second card line, tech chips |
| `@ty.small.lh@` | `24px` | small line height |
| `@ty.small.weight@` | `400` | small weight |
| `@ty.label.size@` | `16px` | label: badges, key caps, overlines (upper case), chips |
| `@ty.label.lh@` | `24px` | label line height |
| `@ty.label.weight@` | `600` | label weight |
| `@ty.label.ls@` | `0.3px` | label letter-spacing (overlines) |

## Spacing (`@sp.…@`)

4 px grid (base unit 8). Used for padding and margins; the number is the multiple of 4 px. Positions (left/top) are layout geometry and stay literal.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@sp.1@` | `4px` | 4 px |
| `@sp.2@` | `8px` | 8 px: base unit |
| `@sp.3@` | `12px` | 12 px |
| `@sp.4@` | `16px` | 16 px: gap between buttons |
| `@sp.5@` | `20px` | 20 px |
| `@sp.6@` | `24px` | 24 px: gap between cards |
| `@sp.8@` | `32px` | 32 px |
| `@sp.10@` | `40px` | 40 px |
| `@sp.12@` | `48px` | 48 px |
| `@sp.16@` | `64px` | 64 px (step of the scale, currently not used in the CSS) |

## Corner radii (`@r.…@`)

Radii of rectangles. Circles and pills (radius = half the height) are geometry and stay literal.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@r.xs@` | `4px` | Key caps, colour keys, count badge, small thumbnails |
| `@r.sm@` | `6px` | Cards, chips, track list rows, artwork |
| `@r.md@` | `8px` | Buttons, rail/menu items, settings rows, keys, panels entries |
| `@r.lg@` | `10px` | Toast, offline bar, large player button |
| `@r.xl@` | `12px` | OSD islands, buffering box, classic screensaver box |
| `@r.2xl@` | `16px` | Dialogs, QR panel, Up Next card |

## Focus (`@fo.…@`)

Focus is shown by the accent colour plus a scale on a permanent GPU layer. No z-index change on focus.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@fo.ring-width@` | `4px` | Border width of the moving focus ring |
| `@fo.ring-radius@` | `14px` | Radius of the focus ring (card radius 6 + gap 8) |
| `@fo.row-border@` | `3px` | Border of a settings row (always present, transparent at rest, accent when focused, so focus never changes layout) |
| `@fo.scale@` | `1.08` | Scale of focused cards, avatars, icon buttons |
| `@fo.scale-btn@` | `1.04` | Scale of focused text buttons |

## Motion (`@mo.…@`)

Only -webkit-transform and opacity on small elements; 150 ms or less; ease-out. Reduced motion (.rm) switches transitions off.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@mo.fast@` | `120ms` | Buttons, text swap (opacity) |
| `@mo.base@` | `150ms` | Cards, focus ring, rows/pages scrolling, navigation panel, toast |
| `@mo.slow@` | `400ms` | Ambient background cross-fade (opacity of a full-screen layer, the one exception) |
| `@mo.spin@` | `900ms` | One turn of the spinner (linear, endless) |
| `@mo.ease@` | `cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1)` | ease-out: the standard curve |
| `@mo.ease-std@` | `cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)` | standard ease-in-out (ambient cross-fade) |

## Layers (z-index) (`@z.…@`)

Global stacking order of the app layers (higher is in front). Local stacking inside a component stays literal.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@z.ring@` | `3` | Focus ring, above all rows |
| `@z.rail@` | `4` | Navigation rail |
| `@z.float@` | `5` | Floating controls: pointer arrows, jump bubble, T9 bar, mini player |
| `@z.bar@` | `6` | Hint bar and offline bar |
| `@z.over@` | `7` | Overlay layer (dialogs, panels) |
| `@z.toast@` | `8` | Toast |
| `@z.saver@` | `9` | Screensaver and dev FPS overlay |
| `@z.pointer@` | `10` | Own pointer element (Smart Control), always on top |

## Layout (`@l.…@`)

Constants of the 10-foot layout. Title-safe area is 64 / 36 px (left-right / top-bottom), action-safe 45 / 25 px.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@l.screen-w@` | `1280px` | Stage width (fixed, body never scrolls) |
| `@l.screen-h@` | `720px` | Stage height |
| `@l.rail-w@` | `120px` | Width of the collapsed navigation rail |
| `@l.nav-w@` | `320px` | Width of the expanded navigation panel |
| `@l.content-x@` | `144px` | Left content edge on screens with the rail |
| `@l.safe-x@` | `64px` | Title-safe margin left/right; content edge of full-screen views (player, screensaver) |
| `@l.safe-y@` | `36px` | Title-safe margin top/bottom |
| `@l.panel-x@` | `840px` | Left edge of the right side panel (screen-w - panel-w) |
| `@l.panel-w@` | `440px` | Width of the right side panel (selection, audio/subtitles, help) |

## Icon sprite (`@ic.…@`)

Icon sprite (src/assets/icons.png): one 32 px cell per icon and colour state. Column = icon (order: design/icons/order.json, append only), row = colour state. Sources: design/icons/<name>.svg (28 x 28 view box, drawn into the cell with 2 px inset).

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `@ic.cell@` | `32px` | Size of one sprite cell (width and height of `.ic`) |
| `@ic.row.text-3@` | `0` | `background-position-y` of row 0: icon drawn in colour `@c.text-3@` |
| `@ic.row.text-2@` | `-32px` | `background-position-y` of row 1: icon drawn in colour `@c.text-2@` |
| `@ic.row.text-1@` | `-64px` | `background-position-y` of row 2: icon drawn in colour `@c.text-1@` |
| `@ic.row.on-accent@` | `-96px` | `background-position-y` of row 3: icon drawn in colour `@c.on-accent@` |
